name.value: Cedar House Gallery – Huu Mees Ma As

description.value: Cedar House Gallery is an Indigenous art gallery located at the Ucluelet Government Dock on the Inner Harbour, specializing in works by Nuu-chah-nulth and Northwest Coast artists. The gallery features carvings, drums, prints, paintings, and jewellery by a roster of named Indigenous artists, with a focus on both traditional and contemporary practices. It operates on the territory of the Yuułuʔiłʔatḥ (Ucluelet First Nation) and offers an online shop alongside its physical gallery space.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water, showers, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the content focuses entirely on Indigenous art, artists, and gallery exhibitions.
